name: xsd-to-ir
description: Parse XSD schemas into an IR — generate DB schema, JSON Schema, XSD assertion metadata, and round-trip XML↔DB for S3000L

scripts.ci: npm run lint && npm run check && npm test && npm run test:generate && npm run test:xsd11 && npm run test:xsd11:invalid && npm run test:xsd11:assert-invalid && npm audit --omit=optional && npm audit
scripts.test:mariadb:docker: npm run mariadb:start && npm run test:mariadb
scripts.test:xsd11:rev-004: node scripts/validate-xsd11.js --skip-self-test --xsd s3000l/1_1/s3000l_1-1_lsa_dataset.xsd --xml test/fixtures/rev-004-issue-1-valid.xml && node scripts/validate-xsd11.js --skip-self-test --xsd s3000l/1_1/s3000l_1-1_lsa_dataset.xsd --xml test/fixtures/rev-004-issue-1-nil-content-valid.xml && node scripts/validate-xsd11.js --skip-self-test --xsd s3000l/2_0/s3000l_2-0_lsaDataset.xsd --xml test/fixtures/rev-004-issue-2-valid.xml && node scripts/validate-xsd11.js --skip-self-test --xsd s3000l/2_0/s3000l_2-0_lsaDataset.xsd --xml test/fixtures/rev-004-issue-2-date-only-valid.xml && node scripts/validate-xsd11.js --skip-self-test --xsd s3000l/2_0/s3000l_2-0_lsaDataset.xsd --xml test/fixtures/rev-004-issue-2-nil-metadata-valid.xml && node scripts/validate-xsd11.js --skip-self-test --xsd s3000l/2_0/s3000l_2-0_lsaDataset.xsd --xml test/fixtures/rev-004-issue-2-related-refs-valid.xml
scripts.check: node --check index.js && find src test scripts -type f \( -name '*.js' -o -name '*.cjs' \) -print0 | xargs -0 -n1 node --check

notes.better-sqlite3: SQLite driver — useful for local dev/test (optionalDependencies).
notes.libxmljs2: Native libxml2 bindings for XSD 1.0 validation (optionalDependencies). Requires node-gyp. Falls back to structural check if absent or unsupported.
